I took it for a spin and this feels right. When I dropped in a link it pulled the real page title straightaway, and when a field wasn't there — like the description or image — it told me plainly rather than leaving me guessing, and still let me fill things in myself. I tried a made-up address that doesn't exist, and it still let me save it with the site's name as a starting title, which is exactly the "don't block me when the page is down" behavior I wanted. My edited title stuck both before and after saving, my note came back formatted with its heading and bold and link when I reopened it, and when I tried to save a link I already had, it stopped me and pointed me to the one that's already there instead of making a second copy. Nice touch that it also refused a shady internal address.

This first slice looks solid and does what we said. Please carry on with the next parts — I'm especially looking forward to seeing Read Later, tags, archive, and the search working. I'll do a full review once it all comes together.
